description: Ways of working for Claude Code, one plugin per way. No plugin requires another.

plugins.name: teams
plugins.description: Zuri's AI Framework as a pack: one standing brief per short-lived role (team, programmer, keeper, planning, challenger, release) over the zaf verbs, a doctor hook, and the routines that work alone: objectives, queue, catch-up, retros. The Engineer rules every domain fork; zaf spawn launches the rest.

plugins.name: handoff

plugins.name: nodes
plugins.description: The NODE.inf.json node tree: chart a repository so agents load a path's context from the root down. Per repository, the tree is committed with the code or kept local-only.
